back: The screens, forms, menus and reports through which people enter data and see results.
A description of the users: age, skills, needs, language, device and place of use. It decides the design.
Clear labels, logical order and tab order, suitable controls, defaults, validation with helpful messages, consistency.
Text box: free text. Drop-down or option buttons: fixed choice. Check box: yes/no. Date picker: dates. Button: action.
Heading, left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers, white space, readable font, strong contrast, colour not the only meaning.
Effectiveness, efficiency, learnability, error tolerance, satisfaction, accessibility.
States what is wrong and how to fix it: "Enter 10 digits starting with 07", not "Invalid".
Compare with the criteria and user tests (time, success rate), find the causes of problems, improve and test again.
